acceptance: validate_corpus.py verifies that len(stream_results) matches the configured stream count in run.streams (or config.streams) when present
Explorer pipeline transformer validates stream_results length against run.streams and raises/flags mismatches
Unit tests cover matching, missing, and mismatched stream count payloads
context: Opus review finding O1 on PR #2761 (feat/throughput-corpus-three-engines).
description: In results-data/validate_corpus.py (lines 97-101) and _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py (_stream_count), stream_count is derived solely as len(phases.throughput_test.stream_results). If a benchmark configuration specifies --streams S but fewer or more stream entries are recorded in the bundle, or if run.streams disagrees with stream_results, the discrepancy is silently masked rather than flagged as an invalid run.
